content:
The business operated on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with hours dictated by Ken's sleep schedule.[1] It offered a variety of ways for clients on a budget to achieve a high, such as glue and paint for huffing.[1] It also offered more expensive chems such as Med-X and Psycho, which were kept locked away. Experimental means of attaining a high were also used, such as inhaling brahmin dung fumes. Ken also provided disease cures for sick patients, although he considered that boring.[1]

↑Chosen One: "{185}{}{You know, I don't think you really want to inhale that... crap. Trust me.}" Troy: "{187}{}{What are you talking about?}" Chosen One: "{189}{}{Well, they make that stuff from brahmin shit.}" Troy: "{196}{}{I think you must be... mistaken.}" Chosen One: "{199}{}{No, really. They were originally growing hallucinogens in brahmin shit, but then they discovered that the *fumes* were actually making the workers high. See, it turns out there's this contaminated pre-war protein extract in the brahmin systems...}" Troy: "{205}{}{That's... fascinating. Hmmmmm. Perhaps I could take blood samples from the brahmin in the courtyard, then... thank you, my friend. Thank you very much, indeed. I was curious about the manufacturing process.}" (Troy's dialogue)
